premise: Rabbit's big ears hear his friends whispering about a birthday surprise for him, so he pretends he heard nothing all day — and gives them the most surprised face in the forest.
inspiration: The Emperor's New Clothes (Andersen), turned: here pretending not to know is the kind thing, and the secret stays safe with a friend.
lesson: Sometimes the kind thing is to let friends surprise you.

en-US.title: Rabbit Hears a Surprise
en-US.text: {rabbit:enter} Rabbit had the biggest ears in the meadow. One morning, {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live hold} they shot straight up. Far across the grass, someone was whispering. [whispers] Shh! A birthday surprise for Rabbit, this afternoon. Don't tell! A surprise? For HIM? He could have said, I heard you! But he didn't. {rabbit:live resume} He just nibbled his clover. All day, his friends were funny. {squirrel:enter} Squirrel bounded by and {squirrel:live hold} hid something behind her back, looking very innocent. {bee:enter} {sfx:buzz} Bee buzzed past, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} saw Rabbit… and {bee:go away} zoomed off, giggling. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Rabbit didn't say a word. That afternoon, {raccoon:enter} Raccoon popped up in front of him. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live} He hid his eyes… peeked… {canvas:confetti 0.9 6s} {sfx:popper} [excited] SURPRISE! {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] For ME? cried Rabbit, with the most surprised face in the forest. {all:face happy} {squirrel:live resume} Out came Squirrel's present: her best hazelnut. {bee:live} And Bee hummed a birthday tune. {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} Rabbit's big ears turned pink. They had heard everything. But they never told.

es-ES.title: Conejo oye una sorpresa
es-ES.text: {rabbit:enter} Conejo tenía las orejas más grandes del prado. Una mañana, {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:live hold} se le pusieron de punta. Alguien cuchicheaba, lejos. [whispers] ¡Chsss! Sorpresa de cumpleaños para Conejo, esta tarde. ¡No se lo digáis! ¿Una sorpresa? ¿Para ÉL? Podría haber dicho: ¡Os he oído! Pero no lo hizo. {rabbit:live resume} Siguió mordisqueando su trébol. Todo el día, sus amigos estuvieron rarísimos. {squirrel:enter} Ardilla pasó dando brincos y {squirrel:live hold} escondió algo detrás de la espalda, haciéndose la inocente. {bee:enter} {sfx:buzz} Abeja pasó zumbando, {bee:face surprised} {bee:shake} vio a Conejo… y {bee:go away} salió disparada, riéndose. [giggles] {rabbit:face happy} Conejo no dijo ni pío. Por la tarde, apareció {raccoon:enter} Mapache. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:live} Se tapó los ojos… miró… {canvas:confetti 0.9 6s} {sfx:popper} [excited] ¡SORPRESA! {bee:go back} {rabbit:face surprised} {rabbit:hop x3} [gasps] ¿Para MÍ? dijo Conejo, con la cara más sorprendida del bosque. {all:face happy} {squirrel:live resume} Ardilla sacó su regalo: su mejor avellana. {bee:live} Y Abeja tarareó una canción de cumpleaños. {rabbit:tint #FFC0D0} A Conejo se le pusieron rosas las orejas. Lo habían oído todo. Pero nunca lo contaron.
